The orb sits fully on screen at every size: 136px on phones, 168 tablet, 200 desktop, bottom-right at the page edge (above the safe area).

Mouse: drag the disc, click it for button 1, click the ring top for button 2; keys still work (arrows, WASD, Space, R, C).

Left-handed: a mirror toggle in LINKS puts it bottom-left (per browser).

Press feedback: the zone flashes (glow-active) + the mini paper ring; a 10ms vibration where supported. Calm: the flash only.
Page edge 16 / 24 / 48 is still the Spacing hypothesis (?) — you wanted to look first. Nothing else is cut on a phone except the dev plate (dev builds only anyway).

knowledge.text: The game is keyboard-steered only (SkyPlay.tsx:206 WASD/arrows, Shift, Space, R, C); a tap only holds the silk (:222). The orb is half off-screen (Orb.tsx:55 -right/-bottom clamp). One breakpoint in use: md: ×33.

The orb is the controller (user sketch, 2026-11-19; mapping revised the same day): the center disc is a stick, and pressing it is button 1 (a tap: down and up without moving); the ring has one press zone, button 2 at the top (thumb tip); a side button left of the ring for Cori (guide / help). Same controller for the site and the game.
knowledge.why: One thumb, one object: the orb was already the site's dial; now it also flies the moth.

knowledge.text: Game: stick steers (past 85% of the disc = thruster) · tap the stick (button 1) = tie silk, tap again = let go (slingshot), steering stays free while the silk holds · button 2 = recall · side = Cori.
Site: the stick points at a section on the dial, release to go · tap the stick (button 1) = next entry (opens it), LAUNCH on Play · button 2 = previous entry · side = Cori as a site guide.
The orb stick works everywhere (touch and mouse), fully on screen bottom-right: 136 / 168 / 200px per tier; keys keep working.
Phone: the rail shows dots + the current label; comms collapses to one LINKS button opening a small Frame.
A left-handed mirror toggle (in LINKS) moves the orb bottom-left.
Cori on the site needs her own lines per section (new content) → Scope.

Button 1 = pressing the stick, told apart from steering as a tap: the pointer goes down and up on the disc within 250ms and under 6px of travel. A press that moves is steering; a release after steering is "go" on the site.
knowledge.why: On a touch screen a press on the disc also starts steering; a tap keeps both, and tap-to-tie / tap-to-release lets the moth steer while the silk holds.

agent.brief: Mobile-first tiers (mobile <600, tablet ≥600, desktop ≥1024). The orb becomes OrbStick: one controller for site and game. Everything else per tier is in the table.
rules: OrbStick (home/base/OrbStick.tsx, replaces Orb.tsx + gem/Diamond.tsx): fixed bottom/right = page edge (+ env(safe-area-inset-*)), z-30; size 136 / tablet 168 / desktop 200. Pointer Events (touch + mouse, touch-action none). Zones by where a pointer goes DOWN: inside 70% radius = stick (a tap on it = button 1: up within 250ms and under 6px of travel; anything else steers); ring within ±50° of 12 o'clock = button 2; the rest of the ring = nothing. Side button: a separate <button>, an arc segment left of the ring (~9 o'clock, outside it), guide / help.

Stick output: vector = (pointer − center) / innerRadius, clamped to 1; dead zone 0.12. Game: writes g.stick = {x, y} (SkyPlay reads it like WASD, analog); |v| > 0.85 = thruster (Shift). Site: angle → the nearest of 6 section notches around the ring (the node follows), commit on release (pushState the hash).

Buttons, game: tap the stick (button 1) = holdStart, tap again = launch (Space still holds/releases as before); button 2 = recall (R); side = askCori (C). Site: button 1 = next entry in the Menu list (opens it; Readout: scrolls the Frame down a step); on Play = LAUNCH; button 2 = previous entry (Readout: up); side = Cori guide (needs site lines → Scope).

Button 2 and the side are real <button>s (aria-label "Recall / previous", "Cori, help"); button 1 also gets a real <button> ("Silk / next") hidden under the disc for keyboard and screen readers, and the stick is role="slider"-free: keyboard users already have arrows/WASD. Pressed zone: glow-active in its role color (button 1 gold, button 2 signal, side flame) + PressBurst; navigator.vibrate?.(10). Calm: no burst.
Mirror (hypothesis): a "LEFT-HANDED" toggle in LINKS sets localStorage orb-hand=left → left instead of right.

Rail below 600: dots + only the current label (gold); all labels from tablet. Comms below 600: one Button quiet sm "LINKS" top-right opening a small Frame (GitHub, résumé, contact, left-handed), Esc / outside tap closes.

Info readout title: display 28 below desktop, hero 48 from desktop. Replace every md: with tablet: or desktop: per this table (Spacing's md: → tablet: rule still holds; the 760 Menu + Detail and hero 48 are desktop:).

Game HUD below 600: scanner Plate compact (state only), Disengage label "← EXIT", progress Plate under the scanner, top-left (the orb and its side button own the bottom), controls hint hidden (the stick is the hint).
